## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`go test -race ./...` passes)
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `docs/decisions.md` has a new D-nnn entry if behaviour changed, and the README or docs are updated
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] No inline scripts or handlers (CSP)
